summary: Phases 5-8 tested end-to-end. Backend: 37/39 pytest cases PASS. One CRITICAL bug found (weekly-summary cron route not registered) + one test-side mismatch (documents.view is granted to pros with shared docs, spec expectation was 403 which is fine because the pro sees empty list). Frontend loads correctly with French UI, logo, 5 nav groups and priority queue.

critical.issue: Route decorator missing in backend/crons_api.py — the function `cron_weekly_summary` is defined right after `cron_recap_email` without `@router.post("/cron/weekly-summary")`. Result: 404 Not Found even with valid Bearer token. Add the decorator on the line above `async def cron_weekly_summary(...)` (currently line 181).

minor.issue: A pro receives 200 (empty list) instead of 403. This is by design (docs shared with them), but spec text implied a 403; consider explicitly documenting or restricting to Bureau-only listing.

action_items: URGENT: Add `@router.post("/cron/weekly-summary")` decorator above line 181 of /app/backend/crons_api.py so the endpoint is registered. Without this the Emergent cron for the weekly Bureau summary is silently broken (404) and no weekly notification will be created.
OPTIONAL: If /api/documents is intended to be Bureau-only, guard with require_admin (or require("documents.upload")) in addition to require("documents.view"); otherwise ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/crons_api.py line 180-181: missing route decorator — the recap-email function body ends at 180 and cron_weekly_summary starts at 181 without any @router.post. This is a copy-paste regression.

backend/finance.py period_range uses hard-coded day 31 for month/quarter end which is invalid for Feb/Apr/etc.; mongo string comparison still works because ISO dates sort lexicographically, but risks silently excluding transactions dated e.g. 2026-04-31 (impossible) or including 2026-02-30 (impossible). Prefer computing real end-of-month.

backend/documents.py `is_expiring` heuristic (line 98-100) is overly complex and looks buggy: `doc["expiry_date"] <= iso(now_utc())[:4] + doc["expiry_date"][4:]` is always true when years match. Refactor to `today <= expiry_date <= today+30d`.

backend/exports.py `_sheet()` reuses the default Sheet only for the first call by checking `max_row==1 and title=='Sheet'`; combined with header row (which makes max_row=2 by design), the first `_sheet` may return a new sheet leaving an empty 'Sheet' behind. Prefer explicit `workbook.remove(workbook.active)` at start.

backend/community.py update_contest allows setting status=OPEN without requiring status transition validation; combined with the notification loop `async for u in db.users.find(...) await notify(...)` it can create hundreds of notifications synchronously — offload to background task.
backend/content.py `_get_article` and update_article: PENDING_REVIEW articles are hidden from other pros; but a pro can only see their own drafts (correct). No leaks found.
backend/partners.py public_partner() blacklist is correct; verified via test that siret, clauses, contract_file_ids, contact_email are stripped for pros.
backend/stock.py apply_movement uses `iso(now_utc())` and correctly refuses negative stock. Alert threshold notification good.
backend/server.py exceeds 767 lines — split auth/dashboard/notifications/dogs into their own routers as recommended in previous iterations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke tests (login, nav groups, priority queue, exports panel, activity feed, blog page all present)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin, pro1, pro2, member all authenticated OK.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed articles, formations, library items, social posts, contests, advent boxes (year 2099), transactions, distributions, reimbursements, advantages, partners, terrains, reservations, stock items. Most are cleaned up (archived) at end; a few advent/contest test entries persist harmlessly for year 2099 and marked TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_phases_5_to_8.py (uses conftest.py fixtures: admin_token, pro_token, member_token). The ONLY critical issue is the missing @router.post decorator on cron_weekly_summary in crons_api.py — one-line fix. After fix, rerun `pytest tests/test_phases_5_to_8.py::TestCrons -v`. Frontend testids verified present: sidebar-logo, header-logo, vdc-logo, nav-group-pilotage/communication/gestion/administration/vie-de-l-asso (note the extra dash), priority-queue, priority-{key}, exports-panel, activity-feed, blog-page, admin-dashboard, kpi-*. Login flow via POST /api/auth/login working. Priority queue on admin dashboard is fully populated and clickable.
rca of the issue: The `@router.post("/cron/weekly-summary")` decorator line was accidentally deleted (or never added) between the end of `cron_recap_email` (line 180: `return {...}`) and the start of `async def cron_weekly_summary(...)` at line 181. FastAPI therefore never mounts that endpoint on the router, so hitting /api/cron/weekly-summary returns 404 even with a valid Bearer token. Reproduction: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET' -d '{}' $BASE/api/cron/weekly-summary` -> 404. Fix: insert `@router.post("/cron/weekly-summary")` on the blank line 180.5, i.e. right before the async def.
